name: secedgar-mcp-server
description: Query SEC EDGAR filings, XBRL financials, and company data through MCP. STDIO & Streamable HTTP.

interface.shortDescription: Query SEC EDGAR filings, XBRL financials, and company data through MCP.
interface.longDescription: Read-only access to SEC EDGAR: resolve companies by ticker, name, or CIK; run full-text search across filings since 1993; fetch filing document text; pull historical XBRL financials and frames by friendly concept name or raw tag; build a one-call company financial profile; and compare named companies across concepts on aligned calendar periods. Material events come back as 8-K filings filtered by item code, and ownership runs both ways: insider transactions (Form 4 / 4-A) and 13F-HR holdings parsed from source, plus a reverse lookup from an issuer to the managers reporting it. Data-returning tools also stage their full result set as a DuckDB dataframe for downstream SQL. No API keys required.
